signature: SUBROUTINE DTPTRS( UPLO, TRANS, DIAG, N, NRHS, AP, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$  (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangular matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the i-th diagonal element of A is zero, indicating that the matrix is singular and the solutions X have not been computed.
